nordic_runes.help_content:
🔮 **RUNIC READING SYSTEM** 🔮

**What is the Futhark?**
It is the alphabet of Nordic symbols, each associated with a concept or universal force. Yuki works them with the same respect with which she learned any other art that was not hers by origin.

**Reading types:**
• **Single symbol** - Direct response to a specific question.
• **Three symbols** - Timeline analysis.
• **Five-point cross** - Complete vision of the situation.

**How to use:**
• `!runes cast [type] <question>`
• Example: `!runes cast single What direction should I take now?`

**Available symbols:**
Fehu • Uruz • Thurisaz • Ansuz • Raidho • Kenaz • Gebo • Wunjo
Hagalaz • Nauthiz • Isa • Jera • Eiwaz • Perthro • Algiz • Sowilo
Tiwaz • Berkano • Ehwaz • Mannaz • Laguz • Ingwaz • Dagaz • Othala

Each symbol is a door to something you already know, but have not yet seen.
nordic_runes.types_content:
🔮 **READING TYPES** 🔮

**single** - Single symbol
└ A direct response - Uses 1 symbol

**three** - Three symbols
└ Past, Present, Future - Uses 3 symbols

**cross** - Five-point cross
└ Complete map of the situation - Uses 5 symbols

**runic_cross** - Yggdrasil Web
└ Complete depth reading - Uses 7 symbols

**Examples:**
`!runes cast single How should I advance today?`
`!runes cast three Show me the flow of this situation`
`!runes cast cross I need a complete vision of my current moment`

Choose your type and write your question.
